upload_file: upload a file to Azure Blob Storage with content, filename, content type, and optional path prefix
download_file: download a file from Azure Blob Storage by passing a blob storage URL and returning its bytes
generate_file_name: generate a sanitized file name using original filename, timestamp, or uuid naming strategy
create_azure_blob_backend: create an AzureBlobStorageBackend instance configured with account name and file system environment variables
review_azure_blob_backend: review the AzureBlobStorageBackend class that inherits from BaseFileStorageBackend and AzureBlobStorageLogger
